children.name: Ptereleotris randalli
children.description: Ptereleotris randalli, the Brazilian dartfish, is a fish belonging to the family Gobiidae and subfamily Ptereleotrinae.

children.name: Ptereleotris zebra
children.description: Ptereleotris zebra, the Zebra barred dartfish or Chinese zebra goby, is a species of dartfish native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Ptereleotris microlepis
children.description: Ptereleotris microlepis is a species of the fish is that lives in the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

children.name: Ptereleotris evides
children.description: Ptereleotris evides, the blackfin dartfish or scissortail goby, is a species of dartfish native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Ptereleotris tectus
children.authorship: Schwarzhans, Klots, Kovalchuk, Dubikovska, Ryabokon & Kovalenko, 2024

children.name: Nemateleotris magnifica
children.description: Nemateleotris magnifica, known by a variety of common names including fire goby, magnificent fire fish, fire dartfish, or red fire goby, is a species of dartfish native to coral reefs of the Indian and Pacific oceans.

children.name: Nemateleotris helfrichi
children.description: Nemateleotris helfrichi, Helfrich's Dartfish, is a species of dartfish native to the Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Parioglossus marginalis
children.description: Parioglossus marginalis, also known as the blackmargin dartfish, is a species of dartfish native to the brackish waters of the coast of New South Wales, Australia This may be an introduced species in New Zealand, being brought from Australia in ship's ballast water.

children.name: Gunnellichthys curiosus
children.description: Gunnellichthys curiosus, the curious wormfish, is a species of wormfish native to the Indian Ocean from the Seychelles and Mauritius to the Hawaiian Islands in the central Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Aioliops brachypterus
children.description: Aioliops brachypterus, commonly known as the shortfin minidartfish, is a species of dartfish endemic to the lagoons of Miniloc Island, El Nido, Philippines.

children.name: Pterocerdale insolita
children.description: Pterocerdale insolita is a species of freshwater dartfish known only from Weipa, Queensland, Australia.
